一个用 Python + PyQt6 写的 Minecraft 启动器：扫描本地: A Minecraft launcher written in Python + PyQt6: scan your local versions, install vanilla and loaders (Forge / NeoForge / Fabric / Quilt / OptiFine), install modpacks and mods, and launch the game — all in one window.
这个启动器不向作者发送任何东西。: This launcher does not send anything to the author.
没有统计、没有遥测、没有崩溃上报。作者不会知道你在用它。: No analytics, no telemetry, no crash reporting. The author will never know you are using it.
你的档案信息（包括离线 UUID）只写在本机的配置目录里，不会上传。设置页底部写: Your account details (including the offline UUID) are only written to the local config folder and are never uploaded. The Settings page shows where that is.
启动器不会在后台联网；只有你主动操作（比如以后做版本下载）时才会访问网络。: The launcher never uses the network in the background — only when you ask it to (for example, downloading a version, once that exists).
以后做正版登录时，只有登录那一步会直连微软服务器，启动器本身不做中转。: When Microsoft sign-in arrives, only the login step talks to Microsoft directly; the launcher itself never relays your data.
游戏本身、以及你连接的服务器可能有各自的隐私政策，与本说明无关。: The game itself, and any server you join, may have their own privacy policies. This notice does not cover them.
本软件不是 Minecraft 官方产品，与 Mojang Studios 和: This software is not an official Minecraft product. It is not associated with, approved by, or endorsed by Mojang Studios or Microsoft.
Minecraft 是 Mojang Studios 的商标。: Minecraft is a trademark of Mojang Studios.
